annotations.title: Compare women’s clothing sizes across 60 UK & US brands

description: Compare a shopper's women's clothing size (UK, US or alpha) at one UK or US retailer (e.g. Zara, H&M, Lululemon, Aritzia, Reformation, Gymshark, Marks & Spencer, Oliver Bonas, Rixo, J.Crew, Madewell, Anthropologie) against another brand or all 60 UK and US retailers, using each retailer's own published bust, waist and hip size guide in centimetres.

from_brand.description: Source UK or US brand name or id, e.g. "Zara", "Lululemon", "Marks & Spencer", "aritzia", "gymshark".

region.description: Optional region filter when `to_brand` is omitted ("UK", "US", or "all").

size.description: Size at the source brand: native UK/US number or alpha size, or prefixed like "UK 12", "US 8", "M", "L".

to_brand.description: Optional target UK or US brand name or id. Leave empty to compare against all 60 retailers (or all in `region`).

name: compare_brand_size
title: Compare women’s clothing sizes across 60 UK & US brands
